content:
Jimmy Kimmel on Tuesday night cracked a joke that might’ve sounded just a little too real after a week of near-daily disasters, from last week’s air traffic collapse to this week’s online banking outage.

“This country is running like a McDonald’s soft-serve ice cream machine right now,” Kimmel said. “Everything is broken.”

“This afternoon, FEMA and the FCC conducted a test of the emergency alert system,” Kimmel said, then deadpanned: “Thirty people were killed.”

The audience was silent.

“That was a joke,” Kimmel said. “Wow, we really are in trouble.”

This time, they laughed.

Kimmel said he didn’t realize the alert system was still in operation.

“Shouldn’t that thing have been going off 24/7 every minute of the last two years?” he asked.
